column1: # Stage manifest (design dev-loop.md section 3 and 6): what L3 expects of each Round base at the
# current stage. Columns are tab-separated; "-" means none.
# Stage "transport" (step 7): the original STL is lifted and written alone, with no supports. It
# is a transport test, not a print candidate. The checker measures what a file without supports
# allows (step 11 lane C): H4 (lift) and H7 (model unchanged) pass; H5 is not applicable (the
# emitted model is proved to have no enclosed cavity); H1, H2, H6 and H9 are not applicable (no
# support record exists to touch the model or to be thin); H3 is unverified (the lifted model
# has nothing under it, so none of its islands is held) and H8 is unverified (no record of the
# exact file opened in ChituBox). The overall answer stays unverified, never "pass". A rule
# gets its row here only when the checker measures it; the runner never infers applicability
# from whichever checks happen to exist.
